titulo: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
resumo_original: Rohit Patel is departing Meta after eight years working on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.

titulo: Ford Fathom will be the cheapest American EV capable of powering a house
resumo_original: Ford is rolling out two new chargers capable of powering a home or the grid — so-called V2x capability.

titulo: US government says hackers are now exploiting critical PHP web bugs
resumo_original: The U.S. government cyber agency warns that hackers have figured out a way to exploit the popular PHP software, used in 70% of the web's software.

titulo: Apple unveils new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 chip
resumo_original: The new MacBook Pro comes with 24 hours of battery life, and now features support for Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 connectivity.

titulo: Apple rolls out iOS 27.2 with new Siri AI languages and security fixes
resumo_original: The latest Apple software update for iPhones and iPads includes new features and important security updates.

titulo: Some iPhone Duo screens are already failing, Apple says only a "small number" are affected
